resources.string: Online infrastructure ready for server integration
Developer diagnostics are available in debug builds.
Choose a game mode and enter the simulation.
Client architecture is prepared for a dedicated multiplayer backend.
Client state, lobby flow and synchronization boundaries are isolated from the renderer.
A server endpoint and authoritative backend are still required for real online matches.
Left stick moves, right stick aims and fires
Level up to earn stat points.
The preview runs on the same renderer as the match.
Hold the empty spot under the level card to reopen
The starting hull with one balanced cannon. Learn to circle the polygons, farm experience and pick your first branch at level 5.
Two parallel cannons trade single-shot power for a steady stream. Hold the trigger and walk your fire across a target instead of sniping.
One long barrel with heavy, fast rounds and a wider view. Stay far away, fire deliberately and retreat the moment anything closes in.
A wide muzzle that sprays a fast, inaccurate cone. Fight at close range where the spread cannot miss and use the recoil to slide sideways.
A cannon in front and a smaller one behind. The rear gun covers your retreat and pushes you forward, so kite in a straight line.
Three cannons in a fan that covers a whole lane. Best against groups: point it at a cluster and let the spread hit several targets at once.
Two cannons front and two behind, firing in alternating pairs. Fight while moving through a crowd, it has no blind side.
A refined sniper with even more reach and punch. Pick a firing line, land the first shot and relocate before anyone reaches you.
Fires two staggered rounds per pull, the second right behind the first. Aim slightly ahead of a moving target so both shots land.
Four small barrels that never stop. Individually weak, together they melt anything that stands still, so hold the target and strafe.
One enormous slow shell with brutal damage. Time the shot, let the recoil kick you away from danger and never miss twice.
A front cannon with two rear thrusters that make it fly. Use the thrust to escape, circle around slow tanks and strike from behind.
Four cannons at ninety degrees. It has no back to protect, so stand in the middle of a fight and hold ground while spinning your aim.
Three parallel barrels focused straight ahead. The purest damage-per-second in a single direction, so face your target and never let go.
Five cannons across a wide arc. Superb for zoning: park in a corridor and nothing gets through the wall of fire.
Seven barrels covering almost a half circle with a heavy centre shot. Devastating on approach, weak from behind, so keep enemies in front.
A sniper stretched to extreme range with a huge field of view. Camp the edges of the map and delete anything that steps into your line.
Turns nearly invisible when you stand still and stop firing. Hide, wait for a passing target, land one heavy shot and disappear again.
Five staggered barrels that pour a continuous line of fire down one lane. Lead the target and let the stream drag across it.
An even larger destroyer shell that erases most tanks in one hit. Slow and vulnerable, so fight from behind cover of allies.
Four rear thrusters make it the fastest hull in the game. Use raw speed to ram past defenses, collect kills and outrun everything.
Eight cannons covering every direction at once. It cannot be flanked, so drive into the centre of a brawl and let it grind.
Twelve cannons ringing the whole hull. A rolling storm that punishes any team that groups up. Charge into a crowd and stay there.
Six barrels at an extreme fire rate with a rear thruster. Continuous suppression: hold the trigger and let nothing enter your cone.
An evolved stalker with brutal damage and a thruster to reposition. Strike from stealth, kill in one shot, vanish before the answer arrives.
An annihilator cannon with side guns and twin thrusters, wrapped in the toughest hull. Push objectives head on and out-trade everything.
